import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> graph;
        int[] level, iter;

        Dinic(int n) {
            graph = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            iter = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            graph.get(from).add(new Edge(to, graph.get(to).size(), cap));
            graph.get(to).add(new Edge(from, graph.get(from).size() - 1, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : graph.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] >= 0;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (int i = iter[v]; i < graph.get(v).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = graph.get(v).get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
                    int d = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (d > 0) {
                        e.cap -= d;
                        graph.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
                        iter[v] = i;
                        return d;
                    }
                }
            }
            iter[v] = graph.get(v).size();
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                int f;
                while ((f = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    flow += f;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        String[] nau = new String[n];
        String[] pom = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) nau[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pom[i] = br.readLine();

        int[][] odl = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : odl) Arrays.fill(row, 1000);
        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (nau[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};

        // BFS from start
        ArrayDeque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        odl[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                    nau[nx].charAt(ny) >= '0' && nau[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9' &&
                    odl[nx][ny] == 1000) {
                    odl[nx][ny] = odl[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        // moge array: dimensions [t][n][n][n][n]
        boolean[][][][][] moge = new boolean[t][n][n][n][n];

        // Initialize moge[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                    if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n &&
                        nau[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && nau[i].charAt(j) <= '9' &&
                        nau[ni].charAt(nj) >= '0' && nau[ni].charAt(nj) <= '9') {
                        moge[0][i][j][ni][nj] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Fill moge for k = 0..t-2
        for (int k = 0; k <= t - 2; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (!moge[k][i][j][l][m]) continue;
                            for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                                int nl = l + dx[d], nm = m + dy[d];
                                if (nl >= 0 && nl < n && nm >= 0 && nm < n &&
                                    nau[nl].charAt(nm) >= '0' && nau[nl].charAt(nm) <= '9' &&
                                    odl[l][m] >= k + 2 && odl[nl][nm] >= k + 2) {
                                    moge[k + 1][i][j][nl][nm] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Collect positions with digits
        ArrayList<int[]> a = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (nau[i].charAt(j) >= '0' && nau[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    a.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int V = 2 * a.size() + 2;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            int c1 = nau[a.get(i)[0]].charAt(a.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            int c2 = pom[a.get(i)[0]].charAt(a.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            dinic.addEdge(0, i + 1, c1);
            dinic.addEdge(a.size() + 1 + i, V - 1, c2);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
                boolean reach = false;
                for (int k = 0; k <= t - 1; k++) {
                    if (moge[k][a.get(i)[0]][a.get(i)[1]][a.get(j)[0]][a.get(j)[1]]) {
                        reach = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (reach) {
                    dinic.addEdge(i + 1, a.size() + 1 + j, 1000);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(0, V - 1));
    }
}
